rows.role_title: 中央委員会議長 — Central Committee chair
rows.text: The report says 不破議長 asked the personnel subcommittee to let him withdraw from the office of chair ('議長から退くことを是非認めてほしい'), that the subcommittee accepted it and decided to have no chair ('議長をおかずに、三役体制でいくことを確認し'), and that the standing Presidium approved his withdrawal at its meeting at the end of December ('常任幹部会では、不破同志が議長から退くこと、新しい三役案について、慎重な検討のうえ承認し').

locator.section: paragraphs on the personnel subcommittee and the standing Presidium

rows.role_title: 幹部会委員長 — Executive Committee chair
rows.text: It says the first plenum, just held, unanimously elected the new three principal officers on the outgoing standing Presidium's proposal ('一中総ではこの提案を検討し、全員一致で新しい三役を選出しました'); the printed text omits their names ('（略）').

rows.role_title: 中央委員会議長 — Central Committee chair
rows.text: It recalls that 不破議長 was elected head of the Secretariat at the 11th Congress in 1970, Executive Committee chair at the 16th Congress in 1982 and Central Committee chair at the 22nd Congress in 2000 ('一九八二年の第十六回党大会で幹部会委員長に、二〇〇〇年の第二十二回党大会で中央委員会議長に選出され').
